# FedEx

> FedEx is a global shipping and logistics platform providing package tracking, shipping services, account management, and customer support across multiple countries and regions.

FedEx operates a comprehensive digital ecosystem serving both individual shippers and small businesses worldwide. The platform emphasizes tracking transparency, multi-service shipping options (Express, Ground, Freight), and localized experiences across major regions including North America, Europe, Asia, and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Package Tracking
- Shipment Management
- FedEx Delivery Manager
- FedEx Ground
- FedEx Express
- Account Management
- Advanced Tracking Dashboard
- International Shipping
- Global Regions
- Customer Support
- Small Business Resources
- Mobile App
- Proof of Delivery
- Multi-Service Shipping

## Core Services & Shipping

- [FedEx Global Home - Select Your Location](https://www.fedex.com/): Global FedEx homepage with location and language selection for international access
- [Track & Ship Online or Find Nearby Locations | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/home.html): Main FedEx hub for tracking, shipping, locator, and small business resources
- [FedEx Ground | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/ground.html): FedEx Ground shipping service overview with rates and transit time information

## Tracking & Shipment Management

- [Tracking Your Shipment or Packages | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/tracking.html): Primary package tracking page supporting Express, Ground, and Freight services
- [Advanced Shipment Tracking | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/tracking/advanced.html): Advanced tracking dashboard for managing multiple shipments with GPS and proof of delivery
- [Tracking and Managing Deliveries | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/tracking/guide-for-tracking-managing-deliveries.html): Guide to FedEx delivery tracking, hours, and shipment control options

## Account & Business Management

- [Access & Manage Your FedEx Account | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/manage-account.html): FedEx account portal for billing, address management, and shipping tools
- [Small Business Shipping Resources | FedEx](https://choose.fedex.com/): FedEx Small Business Center with shipping options, tools, and loyalty program

## Support & Help

- [Customer Service and Support | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/customer-support.html): FedEx customer support hub with contact options via chat, email, and phone
- [Contact The Right Customer Support Team | FedEx](https://www.fedex.com/en-us/customer-support/contact.html): Specialized FedEx support contact forms for billing, shipping, and disputes
